text.name: Glaceon

attacks.name: Ice Shot
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

abilities.label: Held Item
abilities.name: Cheri Berry
abilities.text: If Chimchar is Paralyzed, remove the Special Condition Paralyzed from Chimchar at the end of each player's turn.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.name: Combee

attacks.name: Honey Scent
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flitter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

text.name: Munchlax

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Snorlax from your hand onto Munchlax (this counts as evolving Munchlax) and remove all damage counters from Munchlax.

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

abilities.label: Held Item
abilities.name: Pecha Berry
abilities.text: If Piplup is Poisoned, remove the Special Condition Poisoned from Piplup at the end of each player's turn.

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

abilities.label: Held Item
abilities.name: Persim Berry
abilities.text: If Turtwig is Confused, remove the Special Condition Confused from Turtwig at the end of each player's turn.

text.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Floatzel during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Aqua Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

text.name: Buizel
text.flavor: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

text.name: Weavile

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Dark Engage
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Each of your Active Pokémon's type is {Darkness} until the end of your turn. If that Pokémon is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.

attacks.name: Shadow Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 {Darkness} Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Chip Off
attacks.text: If your opponent has 6 or more cards in his or her hand, discard a number of cards without looking until your opponent has 5 cards left in his or her hand.

text.flavor: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

text.name: Burmy Plant Cloak

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Wear Cloak
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Burmy Plant Cloak is your Active Pokémon, you may search your discard pile for a basic {Grass} Energy card and attach it to Burmy Plant Cloak.

attacks.name: Plant Cloak Tackle
attacks.text: If Burmy Plant Cloak has any {Grass} Energy attached to it, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

text.name: Abomasnow

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Glacier Snow
abilities.text: If Abomasnow is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Abomasnow is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Heavy Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

text.name: Chingling

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chimecho from your hand onto Chingling (this counts as evolving Chingling) and remove all damage counters from Chingling.

attacks.name: Inviting Bell
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

text.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Gather Up
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Marvelous Shine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 4 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

text.name: Happiny

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chansey from your hand onto Happiny (this counts as evolving Happiny) and remove all damage counters from Happiny.

attacks.name: Lively
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

abilities.label: Held Item
abilities.name: Wacan Berry
abilities.text: Any damage done to Bidoof by attacks from {Lightning} Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Dull Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

text.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

abilities.label: Held Item
abilities.name: Rawst Berry
abilities.text: If Shinx is Burned, remove the Special Condition Burned from Shinx at the end of each player's turn.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a {Lightning} Energy card and attach it to Shinx.

text.name: Snover

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Snowball Fight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Snover does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

text.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

text.name: Glameow

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Pose
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

text.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

text.name: Stunky

attacks.name: Severe Gas
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

text.name: Pikachu

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Electro Recycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Pichu is anywhere under Pikachu, you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. This power can't be used if Pikachu is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: BikaBika
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
